text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A tremendous cheer rises from the venue 
for Air Groove, who achieved the 
incredible feat of winning the Yushun 
Himba (Oaks) across two generations, 
mother and daughter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reigning supreme as the new queen, she 
responded to the fans' cheering with 
dignified grace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober, who lacked confidence in 
herself, witnessed Air Groove's imposing 
figure and felt a powerful surge of 
admiration for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:

the Queen's march will not stop.
